note: 07 §the spend-honesty law · the three fates of a task, in one workflow. `capped` has BOTH a max_tokens cap and a sourced Wh rate, so it is the only one with a ceiling — and its row carries the three axes without which two honest numbers are incomparable: provenance (WHO produced the figure), scope (WHAT it covers), measured_at (figures rot with hardware generations). `uncapped` has no provable limit: it is COUNTED here and NAMED at COST, once, not once per rung. `unmeasured` will spend but no sourced rate exists for its model: `unpriced`, never a zero. The subtotal is keyed by scope class because watt-hours sum WITHIN a class and never across one. Measured 2026-08-13 · nika 0.108.0.
